Membership How to use Services Discover Friends of the National Library Contact Us X Membership Homepage > USING THE LIBBRARY > MEMBERSHIP Membership Categories Every individual who wants to use the library’s services and facilities must register as a member. Temporary membership One-day membership Rs. 100.00 Permanent membership Three months membership Rs. 500.00 One year membership (annual membership) Rs. 1000.00 Life membership Rs. 2500.00 Institutional membership for one year Rs. 5000.00 Life membership for retired officers of the National Library Free Special membership in relation to the National Free Reading Month – October for a selected category of members Free Ther senior citizens may receive free life-time membership with a payment Rs. 200/- for library membership card.
